releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.171: Diary Lock not-set message appears in the same centered in-app popup box, not in a separate status area or browser alert. Matching signed APK and Check for Update feed; existing documents, saved images, notes, PIN, reminders and app identity are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Diary Lock: when '🔓 Diary Lock Band Karein' is tapped while no PIN lock is set, 'Diary Lock is not set.' now appears in the same centered in-app popup box (with a close button), not in a separate lower status area or browser alert. The matching APK embeds this update.
